name: Inspiration
body:
Benefit(s): A rogue with this talent gains Amateur Investigator as a bonus feat. In addition, she can use her rogue level as her base attack bonus for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of the Studied Combatant and the Improved Studied Combatant feats.
